about_pullquote: We remove trees properly. No shortcuts, no surprises, fair price.
about_para_1: MCJ Tree Services started in Southampton 18 years ago with one principle: do the work right the first time. We've grown from a one-man operation into a trusted team handling everything from routine crown work to emergency storm response. Every member is trained to high standards, and every job is backed by full public liability insurance and certified arboricultural practice.
about_para_2: We're known in Southampton for honesty and speed. We turn up on time, give you a clear quote upfront, and finish what we start. Most customers call us back for their next tree work — that's how we measure success.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About MCJ Tree Services

reviews.text: Had a massive oak threatening the garden fence after the storm. MCJ came out within hours, took it down safely, and cleared every last bit of wood before they left. Professional outfit, reasonable price. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Spent two years looking at an ugly stump in the back garden. MCJ ground it out in an afternoon and the space looks huge now. The lads were tidy, kept the noise down, and finished early. Dead impressed.
reviews.author: Caroline M.

reviews.text: Needed the tree cut back before it took out the gutters. Got a quote same day, job was done the week after. They were careful around the plants below, didn't leave a mess, and explained everything they were doing. Will have them back.
reviews.author: Michael T.
